'''Dhana''' is a Seanchan ''[[to'raken]]'' who takes [[Mat]] and [[Olver]] to the Valley of [[Thakan'dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dhana}} An arrow from the battle below hits her wing, forcing Mat to perform a crash landing after her rider [[Sulaan]] is also injured{{Ref/book|14|45}}.
